nodes.title: READ FIRST - Save masks, then generate
widgets_values:
1. STEP 1 on, STEP 2 off: Track + save, run, and inspect the colored masks.
2. Keep a good branch on Reuse saved while retrying the other.
3. SELECT MASK: 0 = first track; 1 = second; 0,1 = both; blank = all. Colors in the preview show all tracks, before selection.
4. Both branches on Reuse saved: STEP 1 off, STEP 2 on, then run generation.

Maximum tracks: 1-64; 0 also means 64. More tracks can include unwanted areas.
Changing mask indices, replacement images, or generation prompts does not require SAM again. Changing the video or output size does.
Each cache keeps only its latest saved tracking result.
